<!-- Community intake for the first source-only OSS release. For suspected
vulnerabilities, STOP: read .github/SECURITY.md and use GitHub private reporting.
Do not include exploit details, credentials, personal data, internal hosts or
unredacted logs here. -->

## Problem

Describe the expected and observed behavior and its user impact.

## Reproduction

Provide minimal steps and synthetic inputs. Include the version or commit and
relevant browser/runtime versions. Redact private environment details.

## Evidence

Include only sanitized logs or screenshots needed to understand the defect.
Explain whether you can reproduce it consistently and any known workaround.

## Related issues

Link existing reports you searched before filing this one.

## Support scope

The first OSS release is source-only; packaged artifacts and support commitments
are outside this intake. Filing this report does not imply a response or fix SLA.
